title: Engraved Pin

sources.title: Engraved Pin
markers: The '''Engraved Pin''' is a [[Miscellaneous]] item found in [[Grymforge]]. It is the calling card of a [[Harpers|Harper]].

summary: Picking up this pin prompts a DC 10 History check to recognize it as a Harper token.

fields.Acquisition: Loot Jhaam’s corpse near Murmath in Grymforge.
fields.Recognition: On pickup, active party members can identify the Harper pin with DC 10 History.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
